chapters.title: The Article Is an Event
chapters.blurb: An article becomes one addressable kind-30023 event — title, summary, topics as tags, the markdown as content.

chapters.title: Edits That Replace
chapters.blurb: The address is kind:pubkey:d, not the hash — edits replace in place while a fixed-hash link freezes a version.

chapters.title: A File's Name Is Its Hash
chapters.blurb: A file's identity is its SHA-256: the x tag verifies the same bytes across any mirror, and catches a tampered one.

chapters.title: Inline and On-Screen
chapters.blurb: An imeta tag turns a bare link into a rich preview, and a video lists one variant per resolution.

chapters.title: Highlights
chapters.blurb: A highlight is a kind-9802 event whose content is the quote and whose a-tag points back at the article's living address.
